path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: None. Isolated archive checkout and target; all temporary instrumentation removed before comparison.
updated_engine: Working-tree schema 5 selective property/uniqueness maintenance and cached node/edge writes
method: Three sequential fresh-process, fresh-file trials per engine and scale, alternating engine order between trials. Release binaries, batch size 128, 20 repeated read samples. All builds/tests finished before trials. Each demo verifies full lifecycle, identity, repeat-import counts, rollback, queries and reopen. Summary reports medians and ranges. Whole-process wall/RSS include fixture construction and correctness checks. Quick smoke measurements and instrumented profiles are excluded from the comparison.

baseline_phase_profile.method: One separate instrumented baseline release lifecycle per scale. Nested Instant spans collect inclusive and exclusive time/calls; only queries between node-phase markers are aggregated. Trigger UDFs bracket property/uniqueness maintenance, excluding unique-trigger setup/dispatch. SQL prepare and step are separated. Other exclusive spans include work and nested instrumentation overhead. No concurrent builds/tests. Profiling patch is retained separately; it is not part of either comparison binary. Timings identify costs rather than establish speedups.
